words.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: four original Vagrant Story memory-card UI word sprites. Image 1 is the edit target: a square 1024x1024 sheet with FOUR horizontal rows, in this exact order: TIME / SAVE / CLEAR / MAP. Reconstruct only these four existing word silhouettes at higher definition. Preserve the specific original compact, plain uppercase sans lettering, including native letter widths, tight bearings, word lengths, near-uniform stroke weight, the short middle arms of E, narrow M with its deep inner V, the original A counter/crossbar, and the small diagonal foot of R. Do not typeset a substitute typeface, add serifs, italicize, widen the letters or add extra spaces. The fuzzy pixel steps in the reference are sampling artifacts: infer clean continuous straight stems and diagonals and subtly rounded S/C/P/R bowls, with smooth inside counters as well as outside edges. Avoid polygonal bowls and repeated staircase treads. All capitals in all four rows must share ONE cap-height and baseline relative to their respective row; keep each word at the same position and same overall scale as the reference. Small optical overshoot on S/C is fine, no per-letter vertical bouncing. Keep the exact four-row 1024x1024 layout and generous blank margins; do not put the words in a 2x2 grid. Render solid BLACK ink on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, with fine antialiasing only at contours. No labels, shadows, dark borders, texture, ornament, grid, watermark or additional text. We will add the game's original dark surround and colours separately.

hud_surrounds.method: Separate original-palette dark surround; existing face masks preserved

glow.method: Procedural illumination layer on the existing white menu glyphs; no glyphs regenerated
